networks.name: triage_desk
networks.description: Triage the vulnerability findings in a dependency list, asking the maintainers' own security desks, and record OpenVEX decisions.
sample_queries: Which findings in the demo app are critical or high, and what fixes them?
We render lanternmd only from our own authors' posts, with html left off. Does LANTERN-2026-0001 apply to us?
Ask the tidecache maintainers whether TIDE-2026-0002 matters if we only use RedisBackend.
Propose a decision for the minimist finding: affected, we will upgrade to the fixed version.
Can you open a pull request that upgrades lodash for me?

peer_policy.note: Calls the maintainer desks in allowed_peers, each only after the visitor agrees on a consent card. Requests carry a package, a version, an advisory id and a usage question; never names, emails or code.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
